rationale: A YAML tag is the language's only type annotation and it OVERRIDES the scalar's own resolution. `!!str 7` is a string; the pre-fix analyzer read through the tag to the integer underneath and reported valueType=integer for both tagged and untagged values. Four tag forms are pinned because the tag node has zero CHILDREN but is not zero-width: it carries its own text, so `!!str`, a verbatim `!<...>`, a custom `!Widget` and a plain scalar are four different readings of the same construct. Each produces a declared_type reference edge (M60 R9) naming the type the tag writes. `!Widget` deliberately does NOT override the value type: a tag outside the core vocabulary names a type this analyzer does not know, so the declared type is recorded and the value keeps its own resolution.
